name: Demon Lover
review: This guy may not like this album, but I'm a sucker for sad songs and songs about elves.
lyric: She set her foot upon the ship. No mariners could behold, the sails were of the shining silk, the masts of beaten gold.

name: Cam ye o'er frae France
review: While I love folk songs sometimes I'm also in the mood for electric guitar.
lyric: Mony a sword and lance swings at Highland hurdie

name: Twelve Witches
review: One witch with her lyre can charm people into burning themselves alive, while another is just vegetarian. Clearly we should hold them all in dread, but maybe some more than others. I wonder if this this some at some point was about a group of real people.
lyric: Rowan tree, red thread; hold the witches all in dread.

name: Sir James the Rose
review: Steeleye Span may be the perfect band for me because I love songs with a narrative but never vibed with King Gizz.
lyric: Where shall I go for to hide me? For I have killed a gallant squire, and they're seeking for to slay me.
